database.stem: The weekend program of special activities for handicapped children was a great success thanks to those who generously ------- their time.
database.raw_text:
The weekend program of special activities for handicapped children was a
great success thanks to those who generously ------- their time.
(A) voluntary
(B) volunteer
(C) voluntarily
(D) volunteered
database.explanation:
who generously ______ their time是定语从句，修饰
those，横线处应填入以their time为宾语的动词。本句时态为过去时，故
选 (D) volunteered。volunteer one’s time表示“自愿花时间做某
事”。
